svg.aria-label: How the score works: fifteen checks with weights adding to 100. Tender eligibility 50, registry verification 27, integrity and risk 23. PASS earns full weight, FLAG half, FAIL zero. Risk is Low when every check passes, Medium on any flag, High on any fail with the score capped at 72, Critical on a fail in EMD, documents, GST or debarment with the score capped at 45.
svg.text: PASS FULL WEIGHT FLAG HALF FAIL ZERO
marks a check that caps the score at 45
The UI shows exactly which check lost which points.

g.text: FAIL on EMD, documents, GSTor debarment: capped at 45
